faqs.q: Is My Son back to Hoi An the same trip?
faqs.a: Yes. This page covers both directions. The distance back is the same 45 km, and the minutes are still Check on arrival.

faqs.q: Can you go in the rainy months?
faqs.a: Floods are usual from September to November, and storms run mainly from September to December. In a wet week, check the road that morning. Do not treat the valley as a stop squeezed in before a flight.
